install_redcap.description: Check or interactively prepare the RedCap workspace and accept it with a clean 1 UE smoke.

input.mode: No argument for interactive installation, --check for read-only preflight, or --help.
input.REDCAP_INSTALL_MIN_FREE_GB: Optional minimum free-space threshold; defaults to 40 GiB and may only raise the documented baseline.

output.log_path: Timestamped test_log/compiler_logs/redcap_install_*.log for an accepted interactive run.
output.exit_code: Zero only when the selected check or workflow completes.
output.status_field: task_log/tasks.json status for the interactive preparation and 1 UE smoke.

install_redcap.side_effects: --check and --help are read-only. Interactive mode may install uv, synchronize .venv, run the upstream OAI dependency installer, pull images, build project-local RedCap images and the declared FlexRIC service, start and stop installer-owned Compose services, and write logs.

rebuild_local_redcap_images.description: Build ran-build, oai-gnb, and oai-nr-ue local images from the current workspace.

input.REDCAP_REBUILD_RAN_BASE: Set to 1 to rebuild ran-base instead of reusing it when present.
input.REDCAP_DOCKER_NO_CACHE: Set to 1 to disable Docker build cache.
input.REDCAP_BUILD_OPTION: Optional build argument forwarded to the existing Docker build contract.

rebuild_local_redcap_images.side_effects: Builds or replaces local ran-base, ran-build, oai-gnb, and oai-nr-ue images; does not start containers or edit source files.

mmtc_menu.description: Open the RedCap mMTC operator menu or dispatch a supported subcommand.

input.MMTC_ACTIVE_UES: Comma or whitespace separated UE indices in the supported range 1 through 56.

output.status_field: Caller-managed task_log/tasks.json status for long subcommands.

mmtc_menu.side_effects: Help is read-only; install and runtime subcommands may prepare dependencies, pull or build images, start or stop Docker services, and write logs.

generate_mmtc_cn_db_overlay.description: Generate an idempotent CN5G subscriber SQL seed and Compose override.

input.total_ues: Supported UE count, 1 through 56 for the current runtime contract.

generate_mmtc_cn_db_overlay.side_effects: Writes only the requested SQL and Compose override files.

validate_cn5g_clean_seed.description: Validate the repository-owned CN5G base and UE1..UE56 seed in an isolated clean MySQL instance.
validate_cn5g_clean_seed.side_effects: Creates and removes one uniquely named temporary MySQL container; does not attach to or modify existing containers or volumes.

mmtc_smoke_validation.description: Run tracked CN5G and RFsim validation for the selected active UE set.

input.MMTC_ACTIVE_UES: Comma or whitespace separated UE indices in the supported range 1 through 56.

mmtc_smoke_validation.side_effects: Starts and stops Docker Compose services and writes runtime logs; does not edit source files.

validate_redcap_interface.description: Run syntax, path, help, generator, and active-UE boundary checks for the RedCap operator interface.
validate_redcap_interface.side_effects: Creates and removes only validation-owned temporary files; does not start Docker services.

validate_redcap_public_docs.description: Validate required bilingual public docs, routes, encoding, and 29 UE acceptance markers.
validate_redcap_public_docs.side_effects: Read-only documentation and path checks; does not start Docker services.

validate_dapp_xapp_sdk_docs.description: Run the project static source, documentation, path, and evidence-contract checker.
validate_dapp_xapp_sdk_docs.side_effects: Read-only static checks; does not start Docker services.

selftest_dapp_xapp_sdk_contract.description: Run the Python dApp/xApp SDK contract self-test.
selftest_dapp_xapp_sdk_contract.side_effects: Read-only self-test; does not start Docker services.

validate_redcap_oran_sdk_workflow_v3.description: Run the RedCap O-RAN SDK Workflow 3.0 static documentation, contract, and source checks.
validate_redcap_oran_sdk_workflow_v3.side_effects: Read-only static checks; does not start Docker services.
